## End-state / rollback notes

- `registry/events/` — the three new rows above (append-only; the two
  2026-11-18 `staged-p-0bf8b897` rows predate this run).
- `registry/labels.json` — created this run; one stranded allocation
  `sig-2026-11-20.1` (append-only residue of the refused first build).
- `registry/LOCK` — **held** `{verb=stage, acquired_at=2026-11-20T06:48:17Z,
  holder=local}` — stale (the holder was killed at 06:58:43Z). Left held
  deliberately: it is the recorded residue of the interrupted stage; the
  designed recovery is `--break-lock <reason>` on the next release verb.
- `staged/` — 262 objects landed under `staged/r/p-846b3554…/` before the
  halt (create-if-absent, identical bytes — resume-safe; a later
  `release stage --apply` skips them; no `staged` event was emitted for
  them, and there is no unstage verb — recorded, never hidden).
- `registry/catalog.json` — unchanged `{"publications":[]}`;
  `registry/latest.json` absent. Nothing published, activated, or
  promoted — **promotion remained paused throughout** (no
  `sig.promotion-approval/1` exists; none was created).
- Local: candidate tree `/private/tmp/sig-p3765a/work` (~6 GB),
  byte-identical probe `/private/tmp/sig-p3765a/probe`, export
  `/private/tmp/sig-p3765a/export`.

## What is proven vs what remains

- The pipeline machinery works end-to-end against the real registry:
  window guard refused inside AR-3 and passed at 06:30Z; host-clock check
  passed (0.678 s skew); lock acquire/break/held semantics all observed;
  `cut → built → sites` journal rows are real.
- The candidate's integrity manifest is self-consistent
  (`completeness.complete`, 475,040 artifacts) and an identical build
  validates clean.
- **Blocking finding (records the deferral OPEN):** the newest authorized
  export cannot produce the two Astro dists (`web/evaluation.json` and
  its sibling `web/*` artifacts are absent), so `sites` journaled
  `trees:{}`. Without `v/<pub>/` and `s/<pub>/` the S-mode suite's V3
  route-set and V5 crawl legs cannot go green, V14 has no baseline, V15
  has no quality report — a skip blocks (SIG-ENG-042). A green
  `live-crawl` needs a cut path whose export carries the current web
  artifact set (the real cut path — `ops/gcp/export.sh` over the live
  spine at T0 — which needs Cloud SQL access this environment lacks).
- `transparency-acceptance check` still reports both gated legs
  `prepared_not_executed` — the declaration is updated only on green.

`D-P37.65a-1` remains **OPEN** — recorded, never smoothed.
